summary: Vista Energy, S.A.B. de C.V. filed a routine Form 6-K on September 23, 2026, announcing the timing of its third-quarter 2026 results rather than any special situation. The Mexico City-based oil and gas issuer (NYSE: VIST; BMV: VISTA) said consolidated financial statements will be released Wednesday, October 28, 2026, after market close, with a webcast Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:00 am Mexico City time (10:00 am ET). No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed. Watch for quarterly earnings and operational updates.
